LESSON: READING 3.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: VOCABULARY BUILDING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building, part of Strand 3 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How do we develop library skills? 2. How can we identify appropriate material for reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss ways of accessing reading materials on a specific theme from a library,

2. work jointly to select relevant reading materials based on the theme,

3. use a digital and any other electronic device to access grade-appropriate reading materials on the theme,

4. read the materials and make brief notes on the main points in the texts,

5. identify vocabulary from the text and use the dictionary to find their meaning,

6. team up to build a vocabulary bank on the new words identified,

7. use the new words to construct sentences,

8. peer review each other’s sentences. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss ways of accessing reading materials on a specific theme from a library,
2. work jointly to select relevant reading materials based on the theme,
3. use a digital and any other electronic device to access grade-appropriate reading materials on the theme,
4. read the materials and make brief notes on the main points in the texts,
5. identify vocabulary from the text and use the dictionary to find their meaning,
6. team up to build a vocabulary bank on the new words identified,
7. use the new words to construct sentences,
8. peer review each other’s sentences. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is realised when the learner recognises the value of other people’s ideas as

they peer review each other’s sentences.

• Learning to Learn: This is enhanced as the learner independently identifies vocabulary from texts and uses the

dictionary to find meaning.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is realised as the learner diligently selects relevant material for reading on the theme.

• Unity: This is nurtured as the learner cooperates with peers to discuss ways of accessing reading materials from a

library.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cyber security awareness is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices responsibly to access reading materials.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can employ the knowledge of library skills in all the other learning areas.
